t: RubyDoc.info: File: README – Documentation for anystyle-parser (0.8.2) – RubyDoc.info
s: It is inspired by ParsCit and FreeCite; Anystyle-Parser uses machine learning algorithms and is designed for raw speed (it uses wapiti based conditional random fields and Kyoto Cabinet or Redis as a key-value store), flexibility (it is easy to train the model with data that is relevant to your parsing needs), and compatibility (Anystyle-Parser exports to Ruby Hashes, BibTeX, or the CSL/CiteProc JSON format).
